output.format: single image containing all carousel slides as separate panels

style: clean editorial social carousel, premium consulting brand, high contrast typography, generous whitespace, structured visual hierarchy, subtle abstract illustrations, no clutter

brand_system.typography: bold geometric sans headlines, readable modern sans body, small uppercase labels
brand_system.composition: one core idea per slide, large headline, one visual anchor, short supporting copy, consistent slide number

layout_rules: Create one clearly separated portrait slide panel per carousel slide.
Keep all text exactly as supplied in the slide list.
Every slide gets one hero line only; supporting text must be smaller and readable.
Use consistent margins, slide numbers, and visual motif across all slides.
Where illustrations or photos appear, create new visuals that fit the slide copy and match the same visual style.
Do not overcrowd slides. If copy is long, prioritize hierarchy and line breaks.
